digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and RUF rule enforcement
propositions: 142 actionable RUF diagnostics exist against current origin/main when running the narrow census command with Ruff 0.16.1, distributed across RUF codes including RUF059, RUF022, RUF005, RUF012, RUF043, RUF023, RUF028, RUF019, RUF046, and RUF102.
RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 must remain globally deferred in [tool.ruff.lint].ignore because many flagged Unicode symbols are intentional prose or UI content.

The ratchet test must enforce that [tool.ruff.lint].select contains RUF, [tool.ruff.lint].ignore is exactly the three-item deferral set, extend-ignore is absent, and per-file-ignores contains no RUF-prefixed codes.
After safe mechanical remediation and manual resolution of enabled RUF diagnostics, ruff check with the full configured rule set must exit 0 and stale RUF100 noqa suppressions must be removed.
The implementation must begin from and only modify files reported by the live narrow-census baseline command against current origin/main.
